title: Have a transport security program (airports and air services)
what: Operators of security controlled airports and prescribed air services, and other listed participants, must have a transport security program.

sources.title: Aviation Transport Security Act 2004
sources.quote: 12 Who must have a program (1) The following aviation industry participants are required to have a transport security program: (a) an operator of a security controlled airport; (b) an operator of a prescribed air service;

reach.condition: if it operates a security controlled airport or a prescribed air service
